329:t_10:29.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's the $$サベージ$$ $$宗介$$ brought back.」

329:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A round body, a barrel torso, short legs, and an endearing face...」

329:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It has so much in common with me, yet some people love it while I'm treated like a sexual-harassment robot... It's not fair...!」

329:t_10:33.en:
$$マオ$$
「Isn't your personality the problem after all?」

329:t_10:35.en:
$$マオ$$
「This is a good opportunity. Big Sis $$マオ$$ will give you a makeover.」

329:t_10:44.en:
$$マオ$$
「You've been reborn from a maggot who thinks only of $$Ｚチップ$$s into an outstanding maggot who thinks only of $$Ｚチップ$$s!」

329:t_10:46.en:
$$マオ$$
「Abandon every weakness! Your life belongs to $$Ｚチップ$$s! Engrave the motto on your heart!」

329:t_10:48.en:
$$マオ$$
「Raise your victory cry loud and clear!」

329:t_10:50.en:
$$マオ$$
「...Good. Now you too can be reborn as a lovable macho man.」

329:t_10:51.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Um... $n is looking utterly horrified over there...」

330:t_000:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Bwahahaha, you idiot! Arena scrap could never beat a third-generation AS!」

330:t_000:1.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Those $$オーガ一家$$ guys were idiots too. They couldn't even imagine what would happen if they defied $$アマルガム$$.」

330:t_000:2.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「I heard you used to belong to $$アマルガム$$ too, Mr. $$ゲイツ$$...」

330:t_001:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「A handsome man never looks back. Only his sideburns sway in the wind.」

330:t_001:2.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「You... Get me more popcorn and cola. Hurry, the best show is about to begin. You can clean up the corpse afterward.」

330:t_001:4.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Now then... $$相良宗介$$. How will you fight?」

330:t_003:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「My obstacles are three $$Ｚｙ－９８$$s... I have no chance in a straight fight.」

330:t_003:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「But $$ナミ$$ staked her future on maintaining this $$クロスボウ$$. I'll make it happen!」

330:t_003:2.en:
$$クラマ$$
「You've come to save the girl, $$相良宗介$$... That's how it should be.」

330:t_003:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have five minutes...! Any longer, and $$ファイヤバグ$$ will surely show up!」

330:t_003:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wait for me, $$ナミ$$! I won't let anyone else be taken from me!」

330:t_004:0.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Can you see, young lady? $$相良$$ is risking his life to save you.」

330:t_004:1.en:
$$ナミ$$
「W-Who are you people...? Why are you after $$宗介$$?」

330:t_004:2.en:
$$クラマ$$
「...It really is unfair to put your life in danger without telling you anything.」

330:t_004:3.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Our organization is called $$アマルガム$$... And $$相良$$ is a soldier of our enemy, $$ミスリル$$.」

330:t_004:5.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Though $$ミスリル$$ has been destroyed, and he's fighting all alone.」

330:t_004:6.en:
$$ナミ$$
「What is he fighting for...? To avenge his comrades...?」

330:t_004:7.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Who knows...? Maybe it's for one woman, surprisingly enough.」

330:t_004:9.en:
$$ナミ$$
(I'm sure that isn't me... Who is she...?)

330:t_005:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wait for me, $$ナミ$$! I'm coming!」

330:t_007:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「I've eliminated the obstacles! Now I just have to save $$ナミ$$!」

330:t_008:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「I've eliminated the obstacles! Now I just have to save $$ナミ$$!」

330:t_010:1.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「You did well to get this far in such an old machine!」

330:t_011:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Damn...! They've taken out my weapons!」

330:t_011:1.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「Mr. $$クラマ$$ says he'll finish you off. Open the hatch and climb out quietly.」

330:t_012:0.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「Is he making a desperate suicide charge?!」

330:t_013:0.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「Impossible! How is such an old machine overpowering me?!」

330:t_013:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「It seems you've only ever fought by the textbook!」

330:t_013:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「The arena's battles broadened my combat skills! And I learned how to use this machine!!」

330:t_013:4.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「Impossible! A $$Ｚｙ－９８$$ is being overpowered by an $$Ｒｋ－９１$$?!」

330:t_013:5.en:
$$クラマ$$
「The electric drive of third-generation ASes made them much lighter, but...」

330:t_013:6.en:
$$クラマ$$
「In a simple contest of strength... wrestling, the previous generation's hydraulic drive has the edge.」

330:t_013:7.en:
$$クラマ$$
「And his machine is an $$Ｒｋ－９１$$... Its simple structure makes it sturdy. Once it grabbed him, the fight was decided.」

330:t_014:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's a $$サベージ$$ for you... It's a good machine.」

330:t_014:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「With $$ナミ$$'s maintenance and my skills added to it, I can't lose to just any opponent.」

330:t_015:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$アル二世$$... I grant you permission to retire.」

330:t_015:3.en:
$$宗介$$
($$クラマ$$...! I'm taking $$ナミ$$ back!)

330:t_016:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Oh my...! Did $$クラマ$$ get beaten?!」
